source_bytes_policy: Only attributed property facts, original paraphrases and URLs are retained. No external full paper, image, table reproduction or downloaded dataset is added; raw-source byte hashes are unavailable and are not invented.
proposed_architecture_rules: Use manufacturer laminate properties for frame comparisons and fiber/yarn properties for tension-only stays or spinning membrane sensitivity.
A cable edge still needs a compressive, rotating or actively forced load-reaction path. Four in-plane tension cables around a stretched membrane cannot maintain a square by themselves.
Architecture changes can alter span, allowed sag, mechanical depth and edge curvature; compare at stated optical/clearance constraints rather than claiming equal performance.
Experiments with CNT and graphene demonstrate real materials, but assuming those fiber properties in an unsupported compression beam manufactures evidence the experiments did not provide.
